description: JSON docstring/reference, NOT a submission file. Each schema lists every declared field, required fields, defaults, enums and constraints. Dictionaries consumed without Pydantic are documented under interfaces. Descriptions are documentation, not accepted config keys. Omitted fields, explicit null, and empty objects are not universally interchangeable.

entry_points.workflow: spires-batch workflow plan CONFIG --output PLAN; config_type=workflow, schema_version=1
entry_points.daily_request: spires-batch plan CONFIG --output PLAN; config_type=batch_request, schema_version=1
entry_points.historical: spires-batch historical plan CONFIG --output PLAN; config_type=historical, schema_version=1 (inclusive start/stop). render-slurm writes date arrays; run requires an allocation; assemble binds real receipts for interpolation.
entry_points.interpolation: spires-batch interpolation plan CONFIG --output PLAN; config_type=interpolation, schema_version=1 (all calendar dates inclusive)
entry_points.nrt_cycle: spires-batch nrt cycle CONFIG --through DATE --output DIRECTORY [--execute]; requires an allocation and already registered real history

metadata.description: Free-form operator metadata copied into the resolved input record.

path.description: Directory searched recursively or non-recursively according to pattern.

pattern.description: pathlib-style glob relative to path. NASA filename identities are parsed and filtered by run product and selection. r0_source patterns additionally support {tile} and {year}: expanded from artifact tiles (or selection.tiles) and all calendar years covered by the resolved source windows. Example: {tile}/{year}/VJ109GA.A*.{tile}.002.*.h5. Other placeholders and placeholders on other roles are rejected.

name.description: Required for ancillary, lut, and mask discovery roots.

pattern.description: pathlib-style glob relative to path. Only canonical static-context filenames are classified.

required.description: If true, a missing root or a selected tile with no canonical files is a preflight error.

id.description: Defaults to the path stem when omitted.

path.description: Existing R0 path in existing mode or desired output path in build mode. Use a descriptive filename such as viirs_h08v05_r0_2025.nc, where 2025 is the source summer. Output paths are literal and must be updated when changing tile/year.

water_year.description: Target processing water year (1900–2200), not the summer acquisition year. Required for build-mode recipe defaults unless both explicit date bounds are supplied. WY2026 defaults to summer 2025.

start_date.description: Optional override, supplied together with end_date. In build mode, omitting both resolves the recipe's previous-summer window from water_year. Existing mode does not infer dates.

end_date.description: Inclusive last source date; must accompany start_date and not precede it. Omitting both in build mode uses the recipe's previous-summer window.

scene_preparation.description: Shared preparation options used independently under science.build_r0.preparation and science.invert.preparation.

bands.description: Ordered bands. Omit for labeled R0 products; positional GeoTIFF R0 inputs require an explicit list.

n_workers.description: Workers used within one scientific task. Slurm array concurrency is controlled separately.

canopy_correction_policy.description: When canopy correction is enabled, omitted policies resolve from run.sensor. Explicit policies must match the sensor. Resolved tasks always contain a policy; legacy and retired research labels are rejected.

albedo_science.constraint: At least one albedo/postprocessing operation must be true.

max_concurrent_tasks.description: Total concurrency cap distributed across tile arrays using this profile.

extra_directives.description: Additional literal #SBATCH directive bodies. Use only site-approved directives.

science_python.description: Absolute science Python executable for workers and coordinators; takes precedence over environment_name. Unified workflows inherit scheduler.python when omitted.

root.description: Required when enabled is true. Must be visible to submit and compute nodes.

verification.description: stat verifies size; sha256 is stricter and more expensive.

reuse_valid.description: Reuse an already staged file only after configured verification passes.

cross_field_rules: Unknown fields are rejected everywhere in a runnable request.
Relative paths resolve relative to the request file.
steps must be unique and ordered build_r0, invert, albedo, interpolate.
The batch-request interface does not execute interpolation; use the dedicated interpolation interface or a unified workflow job.
build_r0 requires r0.mode=build, a sensor-appropriate recipe, and r0_source inputs.
invert requires reflectance inputs, an r0 section, and a LUT named inversion_lut.
Selected albedo operations require their named LUT and ancillary inputs.
A tiled static context root advertises supported ancillary and static-mask names during schema validation; discovery and preflight verify actual per-tile cardinality.
update_atomically is supported only for standalone albedo on an existing raw product.
A custom execution profile must supply both resources.cluster and resources.partition.
Explicit tile routing requires profiles, tile_profiles, and coordinator_profile; tile_profiles must exactly cover selection.tiles.
All routed profiles in one operational request must use the same Slurm cluster and environment.
Legacy profile, max_concurrent_tasks, and resources fields cannot be combined with explicit tile routing.
Staging root is required when staging is enabled.
Input filename identities must agree with explicitly declared tile, date, water_year, and product.
R0 start_date and end_date must be supplied together.
For a complete water year, dates=[] means all discovered files in the selected water year; it does not assert that every calendar date exists.

R0 build date bounds default from recipe and artifact.water_year; otherwise both bounds are required. Only available sources within the resolved window and optional selection.dates are selected. Preflight reports source-file count, date coverage, and missing requested dates; gaps warn, while no selected sources is an error.

retrieval_concurrency.description: Concurrent tile/date subprocesses after whole-domain cloud inference. Defaults to all nonmissing tiles. Each subprocess runs one inversion worker with numerical-library threads limited to one. Request at least this many CPUs per task; smaller allocations fail rather than silently serialize. A smaller explicit value permits queued tile retrievals. This applies to historical prepare_date as well as NRT.

retrieval_memory_gib.description: Alternative per-worker memory budget, not an RSS limit. Mutually exclusive with preparation_memory_gib. When neither is specified, defaults to 6 GiB per concurrent tile plus 2 GiB coordinator headroom. Cloud and subsequent interpolation may require more. Slurm memory/CPU checks use allocation environment variables when available; outside Slurm, the caller must enforce reservations.

preparation_memory_gib.description: Direct total allocation budget in GiB for one date's cloud preparation, concurrent retrievals and coordinator. No additional per-tile multiplication or headroom is added. Mutually exclusive with retrieval_memory_gib. Set the Slurm --mem request to this value or greater; JSON checks an existing allocation, it does not submit or resize jobs. The five-tile example uses 16. Later interpolation may need a separately sized allocation.

scheduler.description: Optional shared resource profile. Supplies preparation concurrency/memory defaults and archives resolved configuration; does not submit, resize an allocation or change the stream interpolation recipe.

notes: Run inside an allocation. Even without --execute, acquisition, matched clouds and retrieval run.

See schemas.historical for every top-level field and scheduler option. Nested preparation is a recipe fragment, not a standalone nrt_cycle config: it has no config_type/schema_version header and uses science_python, cloud_python, cloud_model, collection, observation_policy, retrieval_concurrency, retrieval_memory_gib, preparation_memory_gib and tiles. stream_root, through and annual_bright_soil are not historical preparation options.

Tile/WY retrieval bindings follow interfaces.retrieval_recipe. terrain uses mapped_field bindings for dem (metres), slope and aspect (degrees). Daily albedo is evaluated only for state=2 and screening_flags=0; no interpolation is performed.

missing_reflectance defaults to error: missing local tile/dates stop planning. Explicit allow records each absent tile/date and search pattern in missing_sources, writes a null source inventory entry, and permits a missing-observation receipt. Receipt assembly verifies the saved plan and writes null daily mappings, expanded by interpolation into unknown state and NaN scientific fields. No fake reflectance or empty raster is written. These gaps remain null in NRT history and can be revisited. The planner does not query upstream availability; the operator authorizes local gaps. Duplicate vintages, corrupt existing files, inaccessible archive roots and sources lost or newly appearing after planning still fail. Start and stop dates are both inclusive (historical schema_version=1).

safety: All public configurations require config_type and schema_version. All kinds use draft version 1 with inclusive calendar bounds. To preserve an earlier draft historical/interpolation range with an exclusive stop, subtract one day from that stop and regenerate the plan; keep version 1. Unsupported/missing headers are rejected; no implicit migration occurs. Saved-plan/checkpoint formats and scientific component versions are separate contracts.
Planning a universal workflow does not download or compute; nrt cycle without --execute DOES acquire, prepare clouds and retrieve before stopping at the revision plan.
JSON has no comments. Do not paste this reference's description/type/default wrappers into a runnable request.
Scientific recipe constants are not user-adjustable JSON options. Only evaluated NOAA-20 viirs_snow interpolation is enabled.
R0 loads every summer scene for a tile/year into RAM; zarr_path, zarr_mode and chunks are rejected.
Full-history NRT replay stops with status 3 and a transfer-size report instead of silently staging all history.
Use exclusive full-node blanca-snow allocations for high-memory R0; other work uses blanca-snow/blanca-rittger and approved preemptable overflow with the verified exclusion list.
Runtime dictionary parsers do not all reject unknown keys. This reference documents consumed keys, not a promise of complete machine validation.
